item.title: First Post: Setup
item.description: Heya guys, its me! TheCyberCat. I just started this cool new blog, and for my first blog post, I’m going to tell you how I set it up! (it was not easy) Anyways, first I needed a domain to host it on. I decided on thecyber.cat (the site you’re on now), but getting it wasn’t easy. First, I had to go to this spanish site called entorno.es, then I had to go through a simply disappointing interface to get to the settings, then stumble through those to get it on github pages! I finally got it working though. Since this is a test, it’ll be short, but thanks for reading!
